summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments on the cipher-box API, specifically addressing concerns about `npm_package_version` reliability in two files.
summary.outcome: Fixed `npm_package_version` usage in `main.ts` and `generate-openapi.ts`, passed type checks, committed and pushed the fixes, and resolved all three review threads.

repo: `npm_package_version` is not reliably available at runtime in the cipher-box API and requires a defensive fallback or fail-fast pattern.

The API has both a runtime entry (`apps/api/src/main.ts`) and a code-generation script (`apps/api/scripts/generate-openapi.ts`) that both reference package version — changes to version handling must be applied to both.

code.finding: Uses `npm_package_version` env var for versioning; needed a fallback for when it is undefined at runtime.
Also references `npm_package_version`; updated to fail fast when the variable is missing rather than silently producing a broken spec.

workflow: GraphQL `reviewThreads` query is the correct way to fetch unresolved PR threads via `gh api graphql`; REST does not expose resolution status.
Resolving threads requires a GraphQL mutation (`resolveReviewThread`); replying to a thread uses the REST comments endpoint with `in_reply_to` as an integer field.
`--field` (not `-f`) must be used for integer values like `in_reply_to` in `gh api` calls.
Type checking with `pnpm typecheck` was used as the validation gate before committing review fixes.

open_items: PR #428 still needs to merge before the 15 bootstrap tags can be created on the merge commit.
After PR #428 merges, 15 bootstrap tags must be created on the merge commit and pushed, then the release-please workflow re-run to get a clean changelog on PR #427.
